sources.supports: Official list identifies currently accepting calls: quantum networking for distributed quantum computing and sensing; harnessing quantum networking to enhance classical applications; semiconductor reliability; conference sponsorships. Cisco says topics can be withdrawn as proposals are funded or interest is satisfied. Research funding FAQ defines eligible PI as full-time faculty or research staff and states U.S.-taxable institutions must be 501(c)(3).

Official page calls it annual and describes prizes plus collaboration opportunities, but the latest competition and winners shown are from 2023; no current 2026 deadline, amount, or application terms are listed.

Current official AI Research overview lists research areas and initiatives, but no AI Research Awards application page, current faculty award cycle, deadline, award amount, or eligibility. The older awards URL was not corroborated.

Official page distinguishes the annual Rising Star Faculty Award and Outstanding Researcher Award from the Hardware Security Academic Award; links recent 2023–2024 winners and does not list an open submission cycle or deadline.
Official 2026 page identifies finalists and says winners will be announced at the Intel Academic Security Conference; no open application dates or amount are listed.
